load_weights: load model weights from disk or HuggingFace into a PyTorch nn.Module using DefaultModelLoader
prepare_weights: prepare and resolve model weight files from a local path or remote HuggingFace repository
get_weights_iterator: get a generator yielding weight name-tensor pairs for a model source with optional prefix
get_all_weights: yield all primary and secondary model weights from a ModelConfig and nn.Module
init_ep_weight_filter: compute local expert ids for expert parallelism weight filtering in MoE models
